remarks: This inviting single-story Palmdale home offers 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and 1,327 sq. ft. of comfortable living space on a generous 6,469 sq. ft. lot with NO HOA! Step inside to a bright and spacious living area featuring a cozy fireplace and an easy-flow floor plan designed for everyday living and entertaining. The kitchen offers plenty of cabinet and counter space and opens to the dining area, where sliding doors provide easy access to the backyard. The primary bedroom features its own en-suite bathroom, walk-in closet, and direct backyard access. Two additional bedrooms provide plenty of flexibility for family, guests, a home office, or hobby space. Central air and heat, indoor laundry
